name: HospitalRun
notes: Volunteer burnout; v2 React rewrite was never completed despite 6.9k stars. Formal closure announced Oct 2025.

name: OpenClinica Community Edition
notes: Community Edition v3.x receives only maintenance updates; all active development moved to commercial OpenClinica Enterprise. No formal archive.

name: credoai_lens
notes: AI model assessment framework for bias and fairness evaluation. Vendor archived — Credo AI moved to proprietary SaaS platform. Triaged as CHAI partner project but OSS commitment was dropped. Do not catalog.

name: CAMEL
reason_known: 7B clinical LLM fine-tuned on MIMIC-III/IV (3.4B tokens) + 100k instruction pairs across 13 clinical tasks. Team explicitly recommends switching to their successor Asclepius. No releases and only 13 commits. Model weights require PhysioNet credentialized access. Do not catalog — check Asclepius instead.

name: Asclepius
reason_known: First shareable clinical LLM trained on synthetic notes (generated from public biomedical literature rather than real patient data). 7B and 13B variants plus Llama3/Mistral versions. Weights publicly on HuggingFace (no DUA). Only 11 commits no releases — repo is a paper accompaniment not a maintained project. Same lab as CAMEL (Edward Choi group). Do not catalog.

name: AI_Clinician
archived_date: No license + MATLAB codebase + dormant since 2019
reason_known: Landmark Nature Medicine 2018 RL model for sepsis treatment optimisation (IV fluids + vasopressors) using MIMIC-III. Historically important paper but code is 80% MATLAB with no license (all rights reserved) and no releases. Dormant since 2019. Microsoft published a Python reimplementation of the cohort extraction only (github.com/microsoft/mimic_sepsis MIT) but that is a preprocessing script not the model. Do not catalog.

name: OpenEDC (legacy prototype)
notes: Explicitly labelled as legacy prototype; current OpenEDC product is proprietary SaaS at openedc.health.

name: Ginkgo CADx
notes: Continuation fork of MetaEmotion original (also abandoned). Archived Nov 2021; VTK/wxWidgets porting complexity cited and diminished maintainer interest.

name: FreeMedForms
notes: Configurable open-source medical suite. SourceForge release 2019; freemedforms.com website also inactive.

name: medintux
notes: French medical cabinet management software integrating Sesam Vitale and CIM10. No updates since 2015.

name: Open DICOM Viewer
notes: Java-based DICOM viewer for web and patient CDs. No updates since 2013; Alpha status at abandonment.

name: Epi Info
notes: CDC-created outbreak investigation and survey tool used worldwide. CDC officially ended support September 30 2025. Community Edition (C#) exists with 24 stars; Python package updated July 2025 but no evidence of meaningful community continuation.

name: oref0
notes: Reference oref0/oref1 algorithm for OpenAPS. Last release v0.7.1 June 2022. Algorithm logic is now embedded directly in AndroidAPS and Trio rather than used as a standalone tool by end users. Not formally archived but effectively superseded.

name: HistoQC
notes: Quality control pipeline for digital pathology WSIs. Last release v2.1 May 2021 — no significant updates in 4 years. 61 open issues unaddressed. Despite 325 stars effectively unmaintained.

name: Cytomine Community Edition
notes: Docker Compose-based installation for Cytomine. Explicitly archived November 2025 and marked no longer maintained — users directed to the newer cytomine/cytomine repository. New repo at github.com/cytomine/cytomine warrants separate evaluation.

name: Orbit Image Analysis
notes: WSI quantification tool with machine learning and Spark-based distributed processing. Last release v3.64 June 2020 — over 5 years without a release. 59 stars. Effectively unmaintained.
